A '''Rodian male''' was the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the first [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in the first [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he appeared along with many senators before the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]]. The Rodian senator worried about the other [[Species/Legends|species]]' (in the mirror of [[Human/Legends|Humans]]) rights and safety.
